pattern: <definite noun subject> ma <reviewed negative finite verb>
principle: Present/general and progressive negative finite forms retain person distinctions; simple-past negative ma cunin is person-neutral in the reviewed CUN paradigm.
source: Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012) — Shaxannada CUN, p. 921
note: Judge only exact reviewed negative morphology in ma context. Do not infer negative forms from suffixes, and do not report a gender/person conflict when the reviewed negative paradigm neutralizes person distinctions.
